clips.title: The story
paras: Brock's List carries the names of mining pupils honored by the guild halls in Ironforge. Brock Stoneseeker, the mining instructor in Thelsamar, compiles the dispatch for students who earn honorary picks.

In Thelsamar, Brock Stoneseeker records the mining pupils who prove their skill. Apprentices must show what they can do before taking on serious work in Khaz Modan's veins. The honored students earn picks from the guild halls in Ironforge, marks of their skill as miners.

Brock's List travels from Thelsamar to the Deep Mountain Mining Guild in Ironforge's Great Forge. A gryphon carries the dispatch from Thelsamar's roost to Golnir Bouldertoe. There, the students' names are engraved on their honorary picks.
